description: This is a short-term qualification to meet the growing need for Last Mile Delivery Supervisor in the country. The Last Mile Delivery Supervisor qualification equips individuals with skills to efficiently manage and optimize the final stage of product delivery. This role involves coordinating transportation, logistics, and communication to ensure timely and accurate distribution. Last Mile Delivery Supervisors oversee the critical process of delivering goods to end customers, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational effectiveness.
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling
